post.description: Current Organizer authority is locked and rechecked before original-response replay. Mutation, revision, replay and required audit commit atomically. Reissue revokes old proof and records replacement lineage under one-active DB constraint. Revoked/replaced proofs never regain validity through replay. No automatic link expiry. Issue/reissue URL responses have encrypted 24-hour replay; secret-free revoke uses ordinary seven-day replay. New command after retention still requires current revision.

AccountSession.name: eoc_session
AccountSession.description: Existing signed HttpOnly account cookie and persisted current session; server derives capability/owner/assignment.

PrivateLink.description: Authorization: PrivateLink <43-character base64url proof>. Capture /private#access= proof before render, strip fragment, retain only in memory. No account/OTP fallback.

EventId.name: eventId
EventId.description: Opaque ID, never an authorization claim.

View.name: view
View.description: Server-derived relationship; selector/role context grants no authority.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque scope-bound cursor, not historical snapshot; no total count.

Revision.name: If-Match
Revision.description: Quoted event revision; current authorized replay precedes stale-revision checks.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Actor/action/resource/key and canonical body fingerprint. Same key/body returns original status/body; changed body conflicts. Retain key/body/precondition on unknown-result retry.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: Existing session-derived CSRF token; not a role or ownership claim.

Availability.description: Configuration-only time/manual policy. Lifecycle is separate; OPEN is not a registration action. No counts, remaining places, occupancy, capacity-used or CAPACITY_REACHED. Default close is event start.

ManagementDetail.description: Current implemented management shape. No owner/admin identifiers, link proof, URL, participant or operational records. Owner-only optional link metadata is not currently implemented.

PublishedDetail.description: Identical PUBLIC/PRIVATE allowlist with event_state. PUBLIC permits PUBLISHED and LIVE; PRIVATE bearer detail remains PUBLISHED only. No management revision, capacity, ownership, credentials, participant or operational data.

access_url.description: Configured FRONTEND_ORIGIN/private#access=<43-character opaque proof>. Only this owner-protected result and encrypted same-key replay contain the proof. Never log or persist in ordinary response storage.

Configured FRONTEND_ORIGIN/private#access=<43-character opaque proof>. Only this owner-protected result and encrypted same-key replay contain the proof. Never log or persist in ordinary response storage.

details.description: Safe field/blocker/current-revision detail only; never reflect unknown submitted keys or protected data.

name.description: Nonblank, server-trimmed; at most 200 Unicode characters in submitted value.
Server trims text before nonblank validation and the 200-Unicode-character limit.

description.description: Server trims text before nonblank validation and the 5000-Unicode-character limit.

public_location.description: Server trims text before nonblank validation and the 500-Unicode-character limit.

image_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL; no credentials or localhost; null clears. Server trims text before nonblank validation and the 2048-Unicode-character limit.

category.description: Server trims text before nonblank validation and the 100-Unicode-character limit.

items.description: Server trims tags before nonblank, uniqueness and 100-Unicode-character validation.

time_zone.description: Valid IANA time zone; numeric offset is not accepted. Server trims text before nonblank validation and the 100-Unicode-character limit.

EventEdit.description: Owner Draft/Published allowlist; only submitted fields change. Admin may submit ONLY name, description, public_location, image_url, category, tags. Reject forbidden fields. Null clears optional fields; validate ordered schedule and coherent registration times. No Live/terminal edits. PRIVATE-to-PUBLIC atomically revokes the active link.

TransitionCommand.description: Only Draft->Published, Published->Live, Live->Completed, and Draft/Published/Live->Cancelled. Cancel requires a nonblank reason and explicit UI confirmation (no confirmation permission flag). No clock-driven transition or terminal reopening.
